rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for downloading a file or other data from the internet or another remote computer.

example.english: I want to download the document now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 soeng2 haa6 zoi3 fan6 man4 gin2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the download or file-transfer process.

example.traditional: 我而家仲下載緊個更新。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 haa6 zoi3 gan2 go3 gang1 san1

rows.note: Use this when you mean the file itself rather than the transfer process.

example.jyutping: ngo5 saan1 zo2 go3 haa6 zoi3 dong2 ngon3
